title: Anatomy of a ComfyUI graph
hook: A small engine that follows ComfyUI's rules shows which nodes run, which come from the cache, and why changing the checkpoint re-runs six nodes, not seven.

verified.claim: The cache key contains the class, constant inputs and ancestors, and no node ids.
The error names and wording in the lab are taken from validate_inputs and validate_prompt.
LoadImage returns a file hash from IS_CHANGED, and CheckpointLoaderSimple has no such hook.
The dead-branch graph ran here, and its unused node stayed idle.

unchecked: The list of cache modes is correct for this version's main.py. Later versions may change the default.
